scope: CPU single-process deterministic input, synchronous local checkpoint save/read and object reconstruction; not power-loss, TPU, multi-host or asynchronous durability.

entries.title: Design an input pipeline
entries.objective: Build and audit a deterministic batched host pipeline.
entries.exercise: Pad the final three-label batch to four elements with zero. Show that an unmasked mean differs, then derive the correct masked mean.
entries.check: What information is missing from a model-only checkpoint for mid-epoch recovery?
entries.evidence: Keep example IDs and predictions, observed outputs, package versions, state inventory, changed-case checks and the diagnosed failure with repair. This is a single-process CPU tutorial; no TPU, multi-host or asynchronous recovery has been validated.

entries.title: Load, batch, and checkpoint order with Grain
entries.objective: Build a Grain source/sampler/batch pipeline and verify its record order.
entries.exercise: Consume two batches, snapshot, and replay the third batch with a new compatible iterator.
entries.check: What makes a fresh loader resume at the saved next batch?
entries.evidence: Keep example IDs and predictions, observed outputs, package versions, state inventory, changed-case checks and the diagnosed failure with repair. This is a single-process CPU tutorial; no TPU, multi-host or asynchronous recovery has been validated.

entries.title: Save model, optimizer, and random state
entries.objective: Checkpoint complete training state with Orbax and replay the next update.
entries.exercise: Advance to step five, save to a new directory, restore and verify step six against uninterrupted execution.
entries.check: Which checkpoint supports replaying the next Adam update with stochastic targets?
entries.evidence: Keep example IDs and predictions, observed outputs, package versions, state inventory, changed-case checks and the diagnosed failure with repair. This is a single-process CPU tutorial; no TPU, multi-host or asynchronous recovery has been validated.

entries.title: Recover data position and resume
entries.objective: Persist model/optimizer/key and Grain iterator position at one boundary.
entries.exercise: Repeat the protocol after one batch and compare the next five batches through step six. Save to a distinct directory.
entries.check: Which evidence supports a consistent restart boundary?
entries.evidence: Keep example IDs and predictions, observed outputs, package versions, state inventory, changed-case checks and the diagnosed failure with repair. This is a single-process CPU tutorial; no TPU, multi-host or asynchronous recovery has been validated.
